name: SNAP
conductingBody: Symbiosis Test Secretariat, Symbiosis International (Deemed University), Pune
eligibility: Graduate from any recognised University/ Institution of National Importance with a minimum of 50% marks or equivalent grade (45% marks or equivalent grade for Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes). Some programmes have additional programme-specific requirements (e.g. engineering degree, work experience, 65% for SSBF dual degrees).
mode: Computer Based Test (CBT) at test centres
frequency: Up to three tests per cycle (December 13, 19 and 26, 2026); if more than one is taken, the higher score is considered for the final percentile and there is no normalization

pattern.marking: 1 mark per correct answer (total 60 marks). Each wrong answer attracts 25% negative marks. No penalty for unattempted questions is stated officially.
pattern.notes: Objective test, each question has four responses. No sectional time limits stated; the candidate may attempt any section in any order. PwD candidates get 20 minutes compensatory time per hour. SIU states schedules and the nature/structure of the test can change at its discretion. Test timings are communicated via admit cards.

registrationFee.category: SNAP registration fee (per test; government taxes additional as applicable)
Programme registration fee (per programme; government taxes additional as applicable)

scoreValidity: SNAP 2026 score is valid only for admission to selected programmes of Symbiosis International (Deemed University) for the academic year 2027-28.

resultAndCounselling: Result is declared on snaptest.org on January 12, 2027 and available until February 12, 2027; the score card printout is the candidate's official result and scores are not subject to appeal or revaluation. Candidates must have registered and paid separately for each programme. Each institute shortlists for its Group Exercise and Personal Interaction (GE-PI) based on overall SNAP percentile, with separate cut-offs per programme; GE-PI dates are on institute websites and all components must be attended. Merit list out of 100: SNAP score scaled to 50, GE 10, PI 40. Category-wise merit/wait-list cut-offs are displayed on institute websites; wait-list movement depends on vacant seats; admission is provisional until fee payment.
